dedup.scope: 182478 concerns Laurent monomial restrictions for multiple Dirichlet series. 196348, 208615 and 210409 concern Dirichlet-series asymptotics or operator/algebra properties. None gives the full cluster set of a single ±1 series at every boundary point.

source_caveats: Step 6 as printed overstates the finite-tail density at ξ=1, where 0–1 sums are real. Step 7 explicitly permits choosing a countable dense X; the selected first proof uses its written nonzero-imaginary-part argument on such an X disjoint from {1}. Its own dense-set passage gives the boundary conclusion at 1. Preserve the original step 6 wording and the alternative route.

The second solution on p. 14 explicitly chooses a dense set A disjoint from {1} and reuses step 6 of the first. That author text also records the nonreal-point scope actually needed for the finite-tail step.
